description:
FILED s514f (Opus, 2026-10-11) from the #3143 detector recount (docs/detector-measurement-s513d.md §7): the 32 sites the gate still announces after #3143 are ALL this one cause.

An import through an export TAG does not carry the imported subs' prototypes to the parse:

    use Encode qw(:all);
    my $s = decode("UTF-8", "abc");     # PCL: 'main::decode' was parsed as a call of a sub it did not know
                                        #      but code that ran at line 1 installed a sub with prototype ($$;$)
    use Encode qw(decode);              # the named spelling: NO detector line (fixed by #3143)

Output is right in both (the paren form passes the same list), so this is detector NOISE today, and a parse difference for a paren-less call (`decode "UTF-8", $x, 1` with ($$;$) vs a list call).  The compiler's import merge (Pl::Parser::_merge_module_prototypes and the export scan feeding it) reads literal names from @EXPORT / @EXPORT_OK; a `:TAG` argument must be expanded through the module's %EXPORT_TAGS (and `:all` / `:DEFAULT` conventions as Exporter does) to the names it imports.  Gate population: encode-shim-01.t's two `use Encode qw(:all)` programs, 17 + 15 sites.  Probe a tag built from a variable (the Math::Complex shape, #365) before trusting a literal-only scan.


CAUSE LOCATED (s514f, same day): tags ARE expanded (Pl::Parser::_expand_import_tags over the module env's import_sets), but the sets are read STATICALLY: Encode's `all => [ @EXPORT, @EXPORT_OK ]` is built from ARRAY VARIABLES, and Text::Balanced's `ALL => [ qw{ &extract_delimited ... } ]` (inside a BEGIN block) carries the `&` SIGIL on every name.  The board's 41 Text::Balanced 05_extmul.t sites (`use Text::Balanced qw(:ALL)`) are this task too.  Fix: resolve a tag list's @ARRAY members against the module's own literal @EXPORT/@EXPORT_OK reads, and strip a leading `&`.

=== DONE (s515a) ===
Pl::Parser::module_import_sets reads a tag the way the module BUILDS it: @ARRAY members (the module's own earlier literal arrays), \@ARRAY, @{$EXPORT_TAGS{T}} (a tag from an earlier tag), tags assigned inside a top-level BEGIN block, $EXPORT_TAGS{T} = [...] statements; a leading & is stripped.  Pl::Parser::use_statements_of adds the `use` of a literal BEGIN { eval q{ use M LIST } } (q{}/''/an interpolation-free "") at the BEGIN's package and site; the prototype pre-merge and the builtin-override recorder read it.  Guard Pl/t/import-tag-01.t (13; 10 fail on the base).  File::Copy everyday program: 0 detector lines (was 17).  The p515a tagimport.pl oracle = perl with PERL5LIB=<lib> (the fixture's `use lib "$FindBin::Bin/lib"` is not seen at parse time: #3201).  The computed-body BEGIN eval stays unread: #3200.  Commit a37a80cb (s515a).
subject: an import through an export TAG (use Encode qw(:all)) does not carry the subs' prototypes to the parse -- the 32 sites the gate still announces after #3143
